app.name: TurfApp
app.tagline: Book a ground, fill your match, build your game.

home.heading: Play more football in Dhaka
home.body: Find a turf near you, book a slot, and fill the remaining spots with players at your level.

player.heading: Your matches
player.empty: Nothing booked yet. Bookings arrive in Phase 03.

owner.heading: Turf dashboard
owner.empty: No turfs yet. Turf registration arrives in Phase 02.

admin.heading: Platform admin
admin.forbidden: You need platform administrator access to view this page.

me.heading: Backend session
me.body: What Django reports for your Clerk session, straight from GET /api/v1/me.
me.signedOut: Sign in to see the backend response.

onboarding.submitFailed: Could not save your profile. Check the form and try again.
onboarding.capNote: Self-assessed ratings are capped at {cap} and shown as unverified until you play a match.
onboarding.noSports: The sports catalogue is empty. An admin needs to add a sport first.

basics.heading: Tell us about you
basics.body: Only your name is required. Everything else helps us match you with the right games.

sports.heading: What do you play?
sports.body: Pick every sport you want on your profile. You can add more later.

skills.heading: Rate yourself
skills.body: Rough is fine — your real rating comes from matches you play.

attributes.heading: Your physical attributes
attributes.body: These are shared across every sport, so they show on all your cards.

fields.weightHint: Optional. Used only to estimate calories burned.

profile.noSports: No sports on this profile yet.
profile.attributesHint: Shared across every sport (DOMAIN §3), so they appear on all cards.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.body: Your profile, what others can see, and how we estimate your calories.
settings.weightHint: Optional. Used only to estimate calories burned; without it we assume {fallback} kg and mark the estimate.
settings.discoverableHint: Turn this off to stay out of search results. Anyone with a direct link to your profile can still open it.
settings.attributesHint: Self-assessed values are capped at {cap} until matches confirm them.
settings.sportsHint: Removing a sport you have already played only hides the card; the history stays.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

adminSports.heading: Sports
adminSports.body: Review proposals from turf owners and keep the catalogue free of duplicates.
adminSports.approveHint: Approving creates the sport but leaves it inactive until you add its formats, skills and stat definitions in the Django admin.
adminSports.notePlaceholder: Note for the proposer (required to reject)
adminSports.actionFailed: That action failed. Reload and try again.
